patch.value: Sentry PM-CLI-2Q: expected snapshot-name validation is captured as a high production error

A single handled invalid snapshot-name outcome from release 2026.7.29 is unresolved at high priority in Sentry. The validation message is useful at the CLI boundary but should be classified as an expected input error rather than a production runtime fault. Duplicate check searched the exact Sentry key, the complete validation phrase, snapshot fingerprint validation, and all-status expected-error classifier items; no exact owner exists.

Invalid snapshot names keep the current actionable CLI validation and nonzero usage outcome; expected handled validation is excluded from high Sentry issue capture; negative controls still capture unexpected snapshot runtime faults; classification and telemetry gates pass
Keep expected snapshot input rejection helpful locally without polluting production error triage
Sentry high-priority inventory reflects genuine runtime defects rather than correct user-input enforcement
The live seven-day Sentry query returns this as one of only two unresolved high groups
